name: xtyle-bbcode-default
title: Xtyle BBCode (default)
description: The built-in fill for the xtyle BBCode component: the mod-zero markup and behavior every app inherits and may override.

markers.data-body: Where the rendered BBCode lands. The element replaces its children wholesale on every render; anything a fill puts inside it is transient. Carries `data-vocabulary` naming the vocabulary the body was rendered under, since the same source renders differently under a narrower one.
markers.data-chrome: The container the edit chrome is built into, on mount, and only when `editable` — so a component that is not editable carries no source box at all. A fill owns everything inside it and may leave it empty.
markers.data-editor: The source Textarea, built into `data-chrome` when `editable`. Its value is BBCode and the element seeds it; a fill may restyle or relocate it but must keep it a form control that raises `input`.
markers.data-controls: The chrome bar around the switch.
markers.data-toggle: The edit/view switch, an `<xtyle-button>` rather than a bare one so it inherits the real control treatment.
